cards.text: Solomon, king of Israel, has the timber and the stone ready (1 Kings 5:18), and now he's about to build the house of the LORD. This is the BIG one, friend. The Bible dates this moment by counting all the way back to when Israel came out of Egypt.

cards.question: Solomon begins building the house of the LORD in the ___ year after the Israelites came out of Egypt.
Solomon starts building the house of the LORD in his very first year as king.

cards.text: Up goes the house: sixty cubits long, with a porch out front, narrow windows up high, and three floors of side rooms all along it, roofed with cedar. The stones were cut at the quarry, so no hammer, no chisel, no iron tool was heard in the temple while it was being built. Friend, I've heard one man hang ONE shelf and it sounded like a drum solo.
Then the word of the LORD comes to Solomon about this temple he's building. Friend, when THAT happens, you stop what you're doing and you LISTEN.

cards.question: God says He'll fulfill through Solomon the promise He made to Solomon's father, David, but there's an 'if.' What does Solomon need to do?

answers.text: Keep all God's commandments and walk in them
Bring a thousand offerings to the new altar
Build the temple bigger than any palace

cards.question: Still speaking to Solomon about the temple, God says what He'll do for the Israelites. What does He promise?

answers.text: Dwell among them and not abandon them
Make them the greatest of all nations
Send them a new prophet every year

cards.text: So Solomon builds the temple and finishes it, then works through the details inside and out, all the way to the inner courtyard. The standout is the Most Holy Place, made for the ark of the covenant of the LORD, with two olive wood cherubim whose wingtips touch in the middle, and GOLD over the whole interior. I spent years in the back of a junk drawer under a takeout menu, and this man's got GOLD on the inside.
The foundation went down in the fourth year of Solomon's reign, in the month of Ziv. Then in the eleventh year, in the month of Bul, the eighth month, the work wraps up.

cards.question: In the end, the temple is finished according to every specification.
From the foundation in Solomon's fourth year to the finish in his eleventh, how long did building the temple take?

cards.text: Keep that apron on, friend. This story's still in the oven.
